title: feat(search): add fuzzy search with fzf-like scoring algorithm

reviews.body:
## Review: PR #16 — feat(search): add fuzzy search with fzf-like scoring algorithm

### ✅ Approved

**Highlights:**
1. **Roadmap alignment** — Directly addresses #17 (fuzzy search), a P2 item.
2. **Well-scoped implementation** — Core fuzzy module (140 lines) with fzf-like scoring (word boundary bonus, prefix bonus, contiguous bonus, gap penalty). No external dependencies.
3. **Good test coverage** — 14 core tests + 5 plugin-search tests, all passing (278/278).
4. **Clean integration** — Adds `fuzzy` option to SearchOptions, toggle in UI, and character-level match indices for highlighting.
5. **No conflicts** — Mergeable.

**Minor notes:**
- Single commit is fine for this scope, though splitting core vs plugin would make bisecting easier.
- Consider adding a brief JSDoc on the scoring constants (why those specific values) for future maintainers.

Overall: solid, focused feature with good test coverage. Ship it.

issue_comments.body:
### Code review

Found 3 issues:

1. The new `fuzzy` checkbox in the panel is dead UI. The checkbox is created via `createCheckbox` (which does wire a `change → commit()` listener), but `commit()` builds a `SearchQuery` without any fuzzy state, and CM6's `SearchQuery` has no `fuzzy` field anyway. The `update()` method has a comment acknowledging that `fuzzyField is not part of CM6 SearchQuery`. The result: toggling the checkbox dispatches a no-op `setSearchQuery`, and `findSearchMatches` (which is the only place `options.fuzzy` is consumed) is never invoked from the panel. The default-on plumbing through `createSearchPlugin({ fuzzy: true })` is also dead — the panel calls CM6's built-in matcher, not `findSearchMatches`.

https://github.com/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor/blob/17b38a0a997fb56a927ba66098f741393704e005/packages/plugin-search/src/index.ts#L510-L529

2. `findSearchMatches` in fuzzy mode emits one 1-character-wide `SearchMatch` per matched character instead of a single span per hit. The regex path (lines 129-140) returns one `SearchMatch` per full hit; the fuzzy path pushes a separate entry for every matched character. A 3-char fuzzy hit on a line becomes 3 distinct matches — break navigation count, replace targeting, and any code that assumes "one match = one span".

https://github.com/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor/blob/17b38a0a997fb56a927ba66098f741393704e005/packages/plugin-search/src/index.ts#L98-L141

3. `replaceAllMatches` is not updated for fuzzy mode. It uses regex unconditionally and ignores `options.fuzzy`. Callers passing `{ fuzzy: true }` get a silent fallback to regex semantics that diverge from what `findSearchMatches` returned.

https://github.com/floatboatai/Nexus-Editor/blob/17b38a0a997fb56a927ba66098f741393704e005/packages/plugin-search/src/index.ts#L142-L155

Lower-confidence flags worth a look (not blocking): line splitting uses `"\n"` only, so on CRLF docs `\r` stays inside `line` and may end up in `SearchMatch.text`; the fuzzy branch calls `fuzzyFilter(query, [line])` per line — wasteful single-element-array misuse, plus the comment "Use the highest-scoring match for this line" is misleading since there's only one candidate; `packages/core/src/fuzzy.ts:42-44` documents an invariant ("word-boundary match always beats a non-boundary match, regardless of gap penalty accumulation") that is overclaimed — gap penalty accumulates linearly and can dominate the fixed boundary bonus over long candidates; and PR #12 implements fuzzy over the same `SearchOptions.fuzzy` surface with a different (line-local window) approach — these two PRs will conflict at merge and need a coordination decision.

@ketd 老师，再次感谢你在 Issue #17 中给出的详细 review —— 这些反馈非常有价值，帮我发现了之前遗漏的问题。
我已经推送了 commit `812ba62`，修复了所有提到的问题：
核心问题（3/3）：
1.fuzzy checkbox 是死 UI（Issue 1）：新增了 5 个模糊感知导航函数（`fuzzyAwareFindNext` / `Previous` / `SelectMatches` / `ReplaceNext` / `ReplaceAll`），通过 DOM 查询检测面板的 fuzzy checkbox 状态，激活时委托给 `findSearchMatches` 执行，未激活时回退 CM6 原生函数。所有按钮和 Enter 键处理都已接入这些函数。
2.单字符碎片匹配（Issue 2）： 将 `findSearchMatches` 的模糊分支改为每次命中输出一个完整的 `from` → `to` 区间（取首尾匹配位置），与正则路径的"一次匹配 = 一个区间"契约一致，确保导航、计数和替换行为正确。
3.replaceAllMatches 不支持模糊（Issue 3）：新增模糊模式分支，调用 `findSearchMatches` 获取匹配区间后从左到右逐个替换，并跟踪偏移量。

低置信度问题：
拆行前 CRLF → LF 归一化
`fuzzyFilter(query, [line])` 改为 `fuzzyMatch(query, line)`
软化了 JSDoc 中词边界不变量的声明

测试结果：Core 157/157 通过 + Plugin-Search 12/12 通过（sample-vault 的 9 个失败是已有的 Windows 路径 bug，应该与本次改动无关）
